category.reason: The current position is marked by a long black tick inside the scale; the local ground truth excludes adjacent short ticks, the whole slider, and the circular controls.

instruction.en: Locate the current position of the color temperature adjustment slider
instruction.zh: 定位色温调节滑块的当前位置。

reference.patch: Added instruction.zh by translating the original English instruction. The original ground-truth region included space beneath the visible long black current-position tick on the color-temperature scale and was wide enough to include neighboring short ticks, so point-in-box scoring could accept locations outside the position marker itself. Replaced groundTruth from [2117.0, 602.0, 2253.0, 568.0] to [2112.0, 594.0, 2201.0, 580.0], in [top, right, bottom, left] pixel coordinates, to focus the accepted region on the long marker and exclude the adjacent ticks and lower blank area. Updated category.reason to describe this visible marker as the fine-grained target rather than the whole slider or circular controls. This revision defines a tighter visual localization region; it does not assert that the original annotation was an invalid interactive hit area.
